story.title: JetBrains reported a net financial loss first time in its tracked history

draft:
Even the most beloved dev tools can hit a financial snag.

JetBrains has posted a net loss—the first in its tracked history. The company’s aggressive push into AI‑assisted features and a higher‑priced subscription model likely stretched its cash flow, while a slowdown in enterprise budgets tightened the market. It’s a reminder that even niche, high‑margin products aren’t immune to macro pressures.

For developers, the real question is whether this will translate into slower feature rollouts or more aggressive pricing. For the industry, it may signal a turning point where open‑source alternatives gain traction as companies hedge against costly vendor lock‑in.

How should tooling firms balance sustainable revenue with the expectation of continuously improving the developer experience?
